package rego

import (
	\"context\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest\"
)

func TestEngine_IsAuthMethodBuiltin(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()

	engine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource("'`
package flipt.authz.v1
import rego.v1

default allow := false
allow if { flipt.is_auth_method(input, "k8s") }
`)))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	allowed, err := engine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]interface{}{
		"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": 3},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, allowed)

	allowed, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]interface{}{
		"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": 1},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, allowed)
}
EOF
gofmt -w internal/server/authz/engine/rego/engine_auth_method_test.go'

item.text:
Added `flipt.is_auth_method(input, method)` to the Rego engine. It maps the supported names to the protobuf method codes, treats `k8s` and `kubernetes` as aliases, and returns the specified errors for missing authentication and unsupported names. Built-in errors now propagate through policy evaluation.

Tests passed: `go test ./internal/server/authz/engine/ext ./internal/server/authz/engine/rego ./internal/server/authz/middleware/grpc`. No delegation was used.
